mods.reason: The Super Mario Party Jamboree port has no way to load mods yet.

files.label: Game app
files.summary: The Mac app MacNativeGames built for Super Mario Party Jamboree.
files.detail: Play opens this app. You choose its name and folder when you build it, for example Super Mario Party Jamboree.app. It keeps its saves, settings and log in ~/Library/Application Support/Super Mario Party Jamboree.

files.label: Base game
files.summary: Your copy of the game itself: the NSP or XCI file you dumped from your Switch.
files.detail: MacNativeGames builds the game app from it and the update, which go in one folder. Reading them needs the keys from your Switch.

files.label: Update
files.summary: Your copy of the game's 2.3.0 update: the NSP file you dumped from your Switch.
files.detail: The game app runs 2.3.0, so MacNativeGames needs this update.
